summary_md: **Tyso Studio ([@tysostudio](https://x.com/tysostudio/status/2116015118178009491))** built **Xenoform**: drop in a song, pick a vibe, and one object morphs into the next on every beat, using LTX-Video and LTX-2.5 locally through the Comfy SDK with stems, MIDI and an MCP server; he drove a full song with Claude. A follow-up invites people to try the work-in-progress repo, built overnight after he heard about the ComfyUI challenge a week earlier, and pitches it as a companion to DaVinci Resolve for music videos ([tysonfarrington-cmyk/xenoform](https://github.com/tysonfarrington-cmyk/xenoform), [walkthrough](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x_zMu29HfDA&feature=youtu.be)).
